Definition: neuter of a presumed derivative of G2766; an earthenware vessel, i.e. jar:--pitcher.
BiblicalUsage: Keramion means a pitcher, an earthen jar for water. Mark 14:13 says the disciples will meet a man bearing a pitcher of water, and Luke 22:10 says the same: follow him into the house where he entereth in.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the man with the pitcher is the quiet signpost to the upper room, where the Lord had already prepared everything.
